''See also: [[Divine Treasure Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Divine Treasures are exceptionally powerful and unique objects that differ from [[natural treasures]]. While [[natural treasures]] can be found in locations like [[Night Wheel Valley]] or gathered in sets, Divine Treasures are often custom-crafted by skilled artisans, soulsmiths, or [[sacred artists]] using rare components such as the [[blood]] and cores of high-level [[Remnants]]. Some are even constructed from [[Abidan]] artifacts or the remains of [[Dreadgods]]. These entities can take many forms, including massive books made of light and Script{{!}}script, [[suits of armor]], weapons, jewelry like bracelets or crowns, celestial spheres, or even functional [[constructs]] like bridges and engines. They are often integrated into a user's [[soulspace]], where they can be activated by feeding them [[madra]] from a specific [[Path]]. For example, some treasures act as armor that rebuilds itself, while others provide specialized abilities like [[spatial transfer]], regeneration, or the manipulation of existence. Some Divine Treasures are designed to link the wills of multiple individuals, such as the golden armor used by the The Eight-Man Empire{{!}}Eight-Man Empire. Because no two are exactly alike, they are considered highly valuable and can serve as symbols of status, Authority{{!}}authority, or immense strength.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Divine Treasures are custom-crafted implements produced by the most skilled artisans across the eight factions to enhance a user's combat capabilities. Within the The Eight-Man Empire{{!}}Eight-Man Empire, these items are utilized in a network to maintain links between its members. Individual examples include the disc-shaped treasure held within [[Calan Archer]]'s [[soulspace]], marking him as a possessor of two such items, and [[Yerin]]'s treasure, which resides in her [[spirit]] as a dark crown featuring a central crack. While the [[Blood Shadow]] has acknowledged the significant power these objects hold, [[Lindon]] eventually cast his own Divine Treasure into his [[void key]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[The Eight-Man Empire]] uses a network of Divine Treasure{{!}}Divine Treasures to link its members.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14">''Wintersteel'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Calan Archer]] has a disc-shaped [[Divine Treasure]] in his [[soulspace]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17">''Wintersteel'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Calan Archer]] possesses two Divine Treasure{{!}}Divine Treasures.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Blood Shadow]] recognizes the power of the [[Divine Treasure]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c20">''Wintersteel'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Divine Treasure{{!}}Divine Treasures are custom pieces crafted by the finest artisans of the eight factions to improve combat ability.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Lindon]] tossed the [[Divine Treasure]] into his [[void key]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref>}}</li>
